summary: 6.0 FAIL: both startup aliases and native persistence now work, with real 8,047 population and much better civic coverage. Scale, local density, whole-scene cost, night/golden lighting, bridge/seating, aerial repetition and seed/restage weaknesses remain. Final current-cycle critique; no further development round authorized.

acceptance.title: Deterministic, and it round-trips
acceptance.detail: Own deserialize twice and restage twice preserve same-seed 611 buildings, 10,017 cells and 3,600 own triangles. Fresh seed 7 produces 654 buildings/10,166 cells; restage({seed:7}) from original terrain produces 622/10,085, failing equivalence. No public terrain reset contract yet matches restage seed. Centroid shifts 0/0/40/40/8/8/0/0/32 m: zero of nine exceed 50 m, below 30%. Seed 7 also fails scale, local camera counts and seating. Actual native save → navigate empty play page → load → load again preserves exact 611 building XYZ arrays, population 8,047, cash 25,848.000405, retained loan, 30 services, 13 landmarks and one line. All save/load events succeeded and errors remain zero (roundtrip.json). No Math.random/Date.now, performance.now used only for profiling.

shotNotes.aerial_6p5: Warm varied crowns, coherent central cluster and river; broad vacant green interiors and repetitive facade grids remain.

shotNotes.aerial_17p5: Warm facades and river reflections; same vacant block interiors, uniform small trees and industrial dominance across river.
shotNotes.aerial_22: Dark blue towers with patterned windows; repeated large bright lamp discs outline streets, with little sense of occupied interiors.
shotNotes.street_6p5: Warm retail windows and balcony facades frame marked intersection; grass corner, shadowed tree wall and sparse visible traffic dominate.
shotNotes.street_12: Readable asphalt, crosswalk and shelter under crisp shadows; trees conceal much of the broad grassy foreground, no confidently visible bus.
shotNotes.street_17p5: Lightened foliage and distant pale sky; repeated facade bands and nearly empty crossing behind a grass corner.
shotNotes.street_22: Lit window bands and retail openings frame road, but foliage blocks the canyon and car headlight spreads look detached from traffic.
shotNotes.skyline_6p5: Central tower silhouette and two river crossings are clear; left mountain road has extreme artificial terraces, bare green gaps remain.
shotNotes.skyline_12: City and river composition readable with sky above towers; abrupt hillside cuts and evenly spaced trees remain synthetic.
shotNotes.skyline_17p5: Severe white sunlight wash consumes right skyline, removing distant facade and industrial detail.
shotNotes.skyline_22: Bright blue sky and dark repetitive tower windows make the city weakly lit; small pools outline sparse outskirts.
shotNotes.closeup_6p5: Warm street canyon, marked signalised crossing and small cars; open grass corners and repeated building details persist.
shotNotes.closeup_12: Crisp crosswalk and signalised junction framed by glass and balcony towers; two open lawn corners and few cars weaken density.
shotNotes.closeup_17p5: Warm sun catches facade reveals, strong blue road shadow, shelter and sparse cars; empty corners unchanged.
shotNotes.roadmask-on: Same-session golden street with road group visible; tree wall and shelter preserved for literal asphalt mask.
shotNotes.roadmask-off: Same session with road group hidden exposes terrain below; scenery and framing remain fixed.

shotNotes.overview_12: Readable full city between river and mountain, with industrial shoreline and central towers; large vacant blocks and extreme mountain highway cuts remain.
shotNotes.night_street_22: A large illuminated tower facade fronts a lawn, with road at the sides; stronger windows but not a dense canyon, foreground tree edges remain.

shotNotes.night_downtown_22: Lit window grids enclose a marked junction and shelter; repeated facade patterns, tree occlusion and sparse street life remain.
shotNotes.interchange_12: Continuous broad highway, three ramp shapes, median and developed local streets; abrupt steep mountain approach and large open green park remain.
shotNotes.bridge_12: Two road bridge directions and port fixtures visible; generic cranes and shallow apron sit among grass, tower clips foreground water.

shotNotes.suburb_6p5: Warm house roofs and long shadows; real bus and defined garden boundaries, but broad lawn gaps and simplified landmark mass persist.

shotNotes.seed7/street_12: Marked intersection and white van behind thin trees; large grass foreground and repeated facade bands dominate.

shotNotes.seed7/interchange_12: Continuous highway and ramp arms amid detached housing, park and dome; unrealistic steep mountain approach persists.
